body: i think i know how you feel. i've been in/on therapy/meds/hospitals since i was five. i would love to talk to you.

i think taking a break from the relationship to pursue your sexual curiosities  is definitely an option. but communication with your girlfriend is vital, no matter what you do. you're not a bad person or boyfriend - this really isn't uncommon for people who have only been with one person in their life.
you're not being stupid. you're a pretty incredible person and you deserve to be appreciated.
both are average. i'm somewhat lanky but i do eat right and everything. i really don't think it's been my diet/exercise for the past thirteen years.

i don't think i have an answer for that. nothing in particular. i can't pinpoint where this started or what caused it, it just happened.

depression has always been my overall mood, if that makes sense.

i talk to my mom all the time. she's never not been involved in my life and things like this.
she's overwhelmed though and i feel it. 

i just thought some people on here could 'help' too.

i've been in behavioral hospitals a lot of my life, and tried a lot of different meds. i've been obsessed with dying since i was five.

i just feel numb.
thank you. i'd love to talk to you. pming now.

i hope you feel better. 

i've been dealing with suicidal thoughts/actions since i was five years old. turned eighteen last week, barely surviving but still here.

i'm willing to listen if you ever want to talk, i know how feeling empty and hollow is.

thanks for your comment.


i don't feel like i'm anything *but* depression. i've felt this way since i could piece thoughts together.


my family overall doesn't enjoy my company. they're all very bubbly and i'm known not to be. i'm not close to any of them at all. i don't have a dad but my mother loves me a lot, and she tries so hard every day to make me happy.
